text: ya raat ko kaam kar rahe ho.
Koi hai jo aapki saari call sambhal leta hai.
kyunki ye assistant jo hai, wo mere phone mein hai, jiska naam hai bhai, Equal AI.
Number saved ho ya phir unknown number ho, Equal AI call uthata hai,
aur bhai meri jagah pe baat karta hai.
Aur call ke baad mujhe actually batata bhi hai ki kisne call kiya, kyun kiya, aur uski poori ki poori summary aur transcription de deta hai.
Kisi ko call back chahiye? Ek tap. WhatsApp pe reply chahiye? Ek tap.
Aur dekho bhai, ye mere paas call aa raha hai isi assistant se.
I am Equal, your personal call assistant.
Main isko instruction de sakta hoon ki kaun se calls ko kaise handle karna hai,
jaise agar bhai delivery wale call kar rahe hon, to bhai parcel mere reception pe chhudwa do.
Ye Hindi, English, yahan tak ki 9 se zyada languages mein answer kar sakta hai.
Aur India mein almost 10 lakh se zyada log is app ko roz use karte hain.
Jaise bade-bade bosses hote hain, apne call ke liye ek assistant rakhte hain, aapke paas ek assistant aapke phone mein aa jayega.
Abhi Equal app download karo, Play Store aur App Store se.
Arre yaar, phir call aa raha hai... koi baat nahi, mera assistant handle kar lega.
